newsitem.title: USA: Oriole Homes Q1 new sales contracts rise.
newsitem.headline: Oriole Homes Q1 new sales contracts rise.

text.p: Oriole Homes Corp said on Wednesday that it has entered into new sales contracts valued at $40.2 million during the first quarter, compared with $36.7 million in last year's first quarter.
Sales closed in the first quarter amounted to $19.8 million, an increase over $16.7 million in last year's period.
The company's backlog of undelivered housing increased 18 percent to $65.3 million as of March 31, 1997, compared with $55.3 million on March 31, 1996, Oriole said.
Oriole Homes said it has received a largely positive response to its newest developments and the newer, more competitively priced models the company introduced.
The average value per unit in the company's backlog was $159,944 compared with $175,562, Oriole Homes said.
Oriole said it expects to report further sales growth during 1997, particularly in the second half of the year, when most of its sales close.
